item.title: Re: a cool battle in a cool war
item.content:encoded:
you might be asking, "but ch00 and ARD, i only count six deaths." well, you forgot to consider la petite mort, as the French say, the little death, which i assure you both Rukmini and Octavia (the clerk who i realized we totally forgot to give a name to in the tale) experienced a number of times over that crazy night. Or it's Octavia's pelvis.

this was originally going to be about a fling between skitter marshall and Rukmini. it mutated swiftly and vigorously.

NOTES FOR TRANSLATORS
– hide block

i'm gonna start doing these because i always wish i had.

a "chickenhawk" is an old gay guy who specifically tries to sleep with much younger men. "grilled chickenhawk" is a pun on that and "grilled chicken"; puns are hard as hell to translate, so don't stress it, but if you want to find an equivalent idiom to "chickenhawk" and come up with your own pun, be my guest.

Rupert learned Japanese from badly subtitled anime. Just insert your language's grammar in between his awful garbage. "baishenpu" is a deliberately misspelled form of "baishunpu", which is apparently the Japanese word for "whore". If you're translating to japanese, I'm sorry, though I'm sure you can figure out a way to get his speech pattern across. ALTERNATE OPTION: make him Rawhide Kobayashi and switch all the samurai stuff for cowboy stuff, but that's more work for you, so only do that if you're really committed to the bit. (seriously though, if you're into doing this for the japanese translation, message me and i can help out with the cowboy bullshit. i would be honored.)

"ヒンゲロ バング" is "finger bang" lazily transliterated into Japanese.

Karen (the awful mom) is interrupted by crossbow halfway through saying a slur for trans women. if you've got one, cut it in half and stick it in there.

if you've got any more translation questions send me a PM! I'm always happy to help.

item.title: a cool battle in a cool war
item.content:encoded:
Happy pride month, motherfuckers, from ARD and ch00bakka.

This tale officially introduces Rukmini Mahakali into the Cool War universe — a freelance assassin with a Master's of Assassination degree from the Rhode Island School of Demolition and a screwed up ethical code to boot. Lives a morally unsatisfying but hedonistically unrivaled life in backdoor soho. Wears platform crocs, bell bottoms ironically, and an army surplus jacket. Think Travis 'Catra' Touchdown. Go nuts.

Special thanks to Randomini, minmin, rumetzen, and TyGently for their critique.

The appropriate theme, of course, is one Ideal for Violence.
